SELECT CAST(T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` AS REAL) / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS EligibleFreeRate
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.SOCType = 'Continuation High Schools'
ORDER BY EligibleFreeRate ASC
LIMIT 3;
SELECT COUNT(CDSCode) FROM frpm WHERE `Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500 AND `FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700

SELECT sname 
FROM satscores 
WHERE cname = 'Contra Costa' 
ORDER BY NumTstTakr DESC 
LIMIT 1;
SELECT T2.School, T2.FundingType FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.City = 'Riverside' GROUP BY T2.School, T2.FundingType HAVING AVG(T1.AvgScrMath) > 400
SELECT T2.School, T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.Phone FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.OpenDate) > '1991' OR STRFTIME('%Y', T2.ClosedDate) < '2000'

SELECT T2.School, T2.DOCType
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Locally funded'
  AND (T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
      SELECT AVG(T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
      FROM frpm AS T1
      WHERE T1.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Locally funded'
  );
SELECT T2.School, T2.MailStreet FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 30
SELECT T1.Website, T1.School FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000

SELECT T2.AdmFName1, T2.AdmLName1
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT T1.Phone FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T1.District = 'Fresno Unified' ORDER BY T2.AvgScrRead LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.`School Name` FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T1.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` > 0.1 AND T2.NumGE1500 > 0
SELECT T2.MailStrAbr, T2.School FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.AvgScrRead ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT T2.City FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` LIMIT 5

SELECT DISTINCT T2.School, T2.Street, T2.City, T2.Zip, T2.State FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Monterey' AND T1.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800 AND T1.`High Grade` = '12'
SELECT T2.NumTstTakr FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T1.MailCity = 'Fresno'
SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode) FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Los Angeles' AND T2.Charter = 0 AND T1.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` < 0.18

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools 
WHERE County = 'San Joaquin' 
  AND StatusType = 'Active' 
  AND MailState = 'CA';
SELECT School, Phone, Ext FROM schools WHERE Zip = '95203-3704'
SELECT T2.AdmFName1, T2.AdmLName1, T2.School, T2.City FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.CharterNum = '00D2' AND T2.Charter = 1

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN StatusType = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Active, SUM(CASE WHEN StatusType = 'Closed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Closed FROM schools WHERE SOCType = 'District Community Day Schools' AND County = 'Alpine'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN FundingType = 'Locally funded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(CDSCode) FROM schools WHERE County = 'Santa Clara'
SELECT GSoffered FROM schools WHERE Longitude = (SELECT MAX(Longitude) FROM schools)
SELECT T1.`Low Grade` FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.EdOpsCode = 'SPECON' AND T2.NCESDist = '613360'

SELECT T1.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`, T1.`District Code`
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine' OR T2.AdmFName2 = 'Alusine' OR T2.AdmFName3 = 'Alusine';
SELECT AdmLName1, District, County, School FROM schools WHERE CharterNum = '0040'
SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode) FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.EdOpsCode = 'SSS' AND T1.City = 'Fremont' AND T2.`Academic Year` = '2014-2015'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account 
INNER JOIN district 
ON account.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' 
  AND district.A3 = 'East Bohemia';
SELECT COUNT(T2.district_id) FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE T1.gender = 'F' AND T2.A11 > 6000 AND T2.A11 < 10000

SELECT COUNT(client.client_id)
FROM client
INNER JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'M'
  AND district.A3 = 'north Bohemia'
  AND district.A11 > 8000;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM account
INNER JOIN disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT T1.account_id
FROM loan AS T1
INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T1.duration > 12 AND T2.date LIKE '1993%'
ORDER BY T1.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT DISTINCT T1.account_id FROM trans AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id WHERE T2.date < '1997-01-01' AND T1.balance > 3000

SELECT MAX(T4.amount) FROM card AS T1 INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.disp_id = T2.disp_id INNER JOIN account AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id INNER JOIN trans AS T4 ON T3.account_id = T4.account_id WHERE T1.issued = '1996-10-21'
SELECT T3.birth_date FROM loan AS T1 INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id INNER JOIN client AS T3 ON T2.client_id = T3.client_id WHERE T1.amount = 98832 AND T1.date = '1996-01-03'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T2.client_id) FROM district AS T1 INNER JOIN client AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE T1.A3 = 'south Bohemia' ORDER BY T1.A4 DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT County, School, ClosedDate FROM schools WHERE StatusType = 'Closed' GROUP BY County ORDER BY COUNT(School) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(T1.account_id)
FROM account AS T1
INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
WHERE T2.A3 = 'Prague';

SELECT 
    loan.loan_id, 
    district.A3 AS district, 
    district.A11 AS average_salary
FROM 
    loan
INNER JOIN 
    account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
INNER JOIN 
    district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE 
    loan.duration = 60;

SELECT T3.A2 FROM trans AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id INNER JOIN district AS T3 ON T2.district_id = T3.district_id WHERE T1.type = 'VYDAJ' AND T1.date LIKE '1996-01%' GROUP BY T3.A2 ORDER BY COUNT(T1.trans_id) DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM district AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE T1.A3 = 'south Bohemia' AND T2.account_id NOT IN ( SELECT T3.account_id FROM disp AS T3 INNER JOIN card AS T4 ON T3.disp_id = T4.disp_id )

SELECT D.A2
FROM district AS D
INNER JOIN client AS C ON D.district_id = C.district_id
WHERE C.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY D.A2
ORDER BY COUNT(C.client_id) DESC
LIMIT 10;
SELECT AVG(T2.amount) FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.account_id WHERE T1.gender = 'M'
SELECT T1.AdmFName1, T1.District FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode GROUP BY T1.AdmFName1 ORDER BY COUNT(T1.AdmFName1) DESC LIMIT 2

SELECT DISTINCT T1.account_id
FROM `order` AS T1
INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
INNER JOIN district AS T3 ON T2.district_id = T3.district_id
WHERE T1.k_symbol = 'SIPO' AND T3.A2 = 'Pisek';
